preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and s.islower() and len(s) > 0 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string si is a non-empty string consisting only of lowercase Latin letters.
The total length of all strings does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the size of the largest subgroup.

postconditions.expression: any(all(strings[j].endswith(strings[i]) for j in range(i+1, n)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: There exists at least one string t such that each string in the found subgroup is its suffix.

postconditions.expression: all(strings[j].endswith(strings[i]) for j in range(i+1, n) for i in range(n) if strings[i] in subgroup and strings[j] in subgroup)
postconditions.description: All strings in the found subgroup are suffixes of each other.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(subgroup) for subgroup in all_subgroups if all(strings[j].endswith(strings[i]) for j in range(i+1, n) for i in range(n) if strings[i] in subgroup and strings[j] in subgroup))
postconditions.description: The size of the found subgroup is the largest possible.
